findings.empty: No findings — all products pass quality checks.

dryRun.limitHelp: Backend may return fewer if a sample cap is reached.
dryRun.empty: Trigger a dry run to see results.

unknown.title: Unrecognized rule: {{code}}
unknown.description: No description is available for this rule.
unknown.remediation: Review the finding details and the GMC attribute requirements.

baseline_required.title: Missing required attribute
baseline_required.description: A required Google Merchant Center attribute is empty.
baseline_required.remediation: Fill the attribute in the source feed or via field mapping.

brand_required.title: Missing brand
brand_required.description: The brand attribute is missing and the category is not exempt.
brand_required.remediation: Provide a brand value or map it from a source field.

gtin_mpn.title: Identifier problem
gtin_mpn.description: The GTIN is missing without MPN and brand, or its checksum is invalid.
gtin_mpn.remediation: Add a valid GTIN, or provide both MPN and brand.

enum_values.title: Invalid value
enum_values.description: The value is not one of the enum values allowed for this attribute.
enum_values.remediation: Map the source value to an allowed value.

conditional_required.title: Missing dependent attribute
conditional_required.description: An attribute is required because another attribute is set.
conditional_required.remediation: Set the dependent attribute, or clear the attribute that requires it.

date_format.title: Invalid date
date_format.description: The date is not ISO-8601 or has no timezone.
date_format.remediation: Use an ISO-8601 timestamp with a timezone offset.

length_limits.title: Length out of range
length_limits.description: The value exceeds or falls below the length allowed for this attribute.
length_limits.remediation: Adjust the value to fit the GMC length limit.

cardinality.title: Wrong number of values
cardinality.description: The attribute has more or fewer values than its kind allows.
cardinality.remediation: Adjust the repeated values to the allowed cardinality.

currency_consistency.title: Currency mismatch
currency_consistency.description: A price uses a currency other than the feed source currency.
currency_consistency.remediation: Use the feed source currency or fix the price currency.

image_requirements.title: Image requirement
image_requirements.description: The image is missing, unsupported, or below the minimum size.
image_requirements.remediation: Provide a reachable image of at least 500x500 px in a supported format.

variant_consistency.title: Variant inconsistency
variant_consistency.description: Variants in a group disagree on shared attributes.
variant_consistency.remediation: Align the shared attributes across the variant group.

volume_drop.title: Catalog volume drop
volume_drop.description: The product count dropped sharply versus the previous run.
volume_drop.remediation: Check the source feed for truncation or fetch errors before publishing.

ai_policy_check.title: AI policy suggestion
ai_policy_check.description: The AI policy check flagged this product for review.
ai_policy_check.remediation: Review the AI suggestion and adjust the product data if needed.
